title: Deewana
plot_overview: An ordinary young man becomes captivated by a woman who seems beyond his reach and struggles to prove himself worthy of her. Meanwhile, she is quietly preparing to move on, setting their hopes on different paths.
will_you_like_this: You may like this if you enjoy romantic stories about longing and mismatched hopes; Not for you if you prefer fast-paced plots or detailed world-building.
review_summary: Pros: romantic premise; contrasting perspectives | Cons: limited plot details; familiar setup
